objective: Define an evidence-complete offline comparison matrix for public agent workflow projects without creating runtime dependencies.
assumptions: Public documentation and repository metadata are evidence sources
A comparison is not an integration claim
unknowns: Maintenance status changes and must be refreshed at review time
invariants: Every compared candidate has an exact revision and license evidence
Maintenance and human-intervention claims cite dated public evidence
The matrix does not imply live integration
acceptance_predicates: LangGraph, AutoGen or Microsoft Agent Framework, OpenHands, and SWE-agent can each be represented
Each row requires all mandatory evidence fields
A stale or missing evidence field fails closed
AWG additions are separated from project capabilities
